clue.text: How to avoid sack when the going gets hot?

definitions.text: How to avoid sack when the going gets hot?

parts.words: How to avoid sack when the going gets hot?
parts.note: read one way it is a dodge for not being dismissed from a job; read the other it is the iron stairway used to get out of a burning building

explanation.surface: Advice on keeping your job when things get heated at work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sack' tempts you towards dismissal; a building's emergency stairway lets you dodge the flames when things literally get hot.
explanation.definitionFit: An emergency exit from a burning building, and punningly a way of evading dismissal.

clue.text: Footballers on the way to being quick

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece sits on top of the next, so the footballers come first

parts.note: FA is the Football Association, the body governing English footballers
ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: Football players heading along the road to becoming nimble.
explanation.definitionFit: Fast and quick are synonyms meaning moving at speed.

clue.text: Worries don't start with money abroad

indicators.note: the word for worries loses its opening letter, so it does not start

parts.note: troubles are worries

explanation.surface: Someone whose anxieties do not begin with foreign currency.
explanation.definitionFit: The rouble is the currency of Russia, so these are a foreign form of money.

clue.text: Businessmen and various peers enter run

indicators.note: various suggests the letters of these three words come in a different arrangement

explanation.surface: Business people and assorted nobles take part in a race.
explanation.definitionFit: Entrepreneurs are people who set up and run commercial ventures.

clue.text: Nursery failing half of credit checks

indicators.note: each of the two words fails by losing its back half, leaving only its front three letters

explanation.surface: A nursery that does not pass half of its financial checks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'failing half of' keeps CRE from 'credit' and CHE from 'checks'.
explanation.definitionFit: A crèche is a day nursery where small children are looked after.

clue.text: Through poetry, becoming irrational

parts.note: per is Latin for through, as in per annum
verse means poetry

explanation.surface: Someone driven mad by reading poems.
explanation.definitionFit: Perverse means contrary or unreasonable, against good sense.

clue.text: Careful examination of works canteen?

indicators.note: of signals the answer is a part taken from the run of letters in the phrase that follows

explanation.surface: An inspection of the factory's dining room.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer straddles the two words: the last letter of 'works' and the first three of 'canteen'.
explanation.definitionFit: A scan is a close, thorough inspection, as in a medical scan.

clue.text: Fancy ring on painter

indicators.note: in a down clue the ringing word sits on top of the painter

parts.note: to chime is to ring, as bells do
RA is a Royal Academician, a painter

explanation.surface: Telephoning an artist on a whim.
explanation.definitionFit: A chimera is a fanciful illusion or wild dream.

clue.text: Sensible? Not in France over meaning

parts.note: non is French for not
on can mean over or upon, as in a lid on a jar
sense means meaning

explanation.surface: Asking whether something is sensible and answering that, in France, it means nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A no-nonsense approach is practical and down-to-earth.

clue.text: Cross-ply required by public transport

definitions.meaning: in weaving the ... carries the weft thread across between the warp threads
a bus or train service running back and forth on a short route

explanation.surface: A tyre type needed for a bus.
explanation.definitionFit: A weaving tool that passes the thread across, and a vehicle shuttling to and fro on a fixed route.

clue.text: Arrange 50% off fare — talk about a queue!

indicators.note: half of the word fare is taken off, its front two letters
talk about signals that the phrase for a queue is said out loud

parts.note: a queue is a line, so this is a line

explanation.surface: A bargain half-price fare, and then a complaint about the queue for it.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing FA leaves RE; 'a line' spoken sounds like the second part.
explanation.definitionFit: To realign things is to put them in order again, to set them out afresh.

clue.text: An attack on the entrée is part of the soldier's training

parts.note: an assault is an attack
an entrée is a course of a meal

explanation.surface: Someone launching into the main dish at a mess dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: An army obstacle circuit of walls, nets and ropes that recruits race over.

clue.text: Isn't he in elect group in the country?

indicators.note: to group things is to arrange them, so these letters are put in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Asking whether a man belongs to the select band in the nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Liechtenstein is a small principality between Switzerland and Austria.

clue.text: Forecast pressure about the way one talks

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for pressure in physics
re means about or concerning
diction is a person's manner of speaking

explanation.surface: Predicting pressure systems, in the style of a weather presenter.
explanation.definitionFit: A prediction is a forecast, a statement of what will happen.

clue.text: Where men are found in relaxation?

definitions.text: Where men are found in relaxation?

indicators.note: the men are located inside the word for relaxation

parts.note: rest means relaxation
OR is other ranks, the ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: Asking where soldiers go to unwind.
explanation.definitionFit: A holiday resort is a place people go for leisure.

clue.text: Strange clues to a word meaning "kiss"

indicators.note: strange suggests the letters of the next words are put in an odd new order

explanation.surface: Puzzling hints to a fancy word for a kiss.
explanation.definitionFit: Osculate is a formal or jocular verb for to kiss.

clue.text: In plot to make beer

parts.note: to be in is to be at home
to brew is to plot or hatch, as in brewing trouble

explanation.surface: Growing hops in a garden plot to make beer.
explanation.definitionFit: Ale made at your own house rather than bought in a shop.

clue.text: University teacher garages old car in province

indicators.note: garages means houses something within, as a car is kept in a garage

parts.note: a don is a university lecturer
the Mini is a small British car

explanation.surface: A lecturer who keeps a vintage vehicle in a distant region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'garages' looks like a noun but is the verb: the lecturer's word is opened between its first letter and the rest to park the vintage car inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A dominion is a territory or self-governing region.

clue.text: People got a hole in one and were threatened

definitions.note: the answer is a past tense, here read as the past participle, threatened

parts.note: men means people
in golf to ace a hole is to get a hole in one

explanation.surface: Golfers who hit a hole in one and then received threats.
explanation.definitionFit: To be menaced is to be intimidated or put in danger.

clue.text: Coaches are a long time on the road

indicators.note: in an across clue the long time comes on, or after, the road

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a road
ages means a long time

explanation.surface: Buses spending forever on the highway.
explanation.definitionFit: Stagecoaches, or stages, were horse-drawn coaches running between stops.

clue.text: Managing to greet us with a sign

indicators.note: managing means handling or arranging, so the letters are reorganised

explanation.surface: Someone contriving to welcome us with a signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A gesture is a movement made as a signal, such as a wave.

clue.text: A fly first engineer on father's side

indicators.note: first says the fly comes before the engineer

parts.note: a gnat is a small fly
E is the abbreviation for engineer

explanation.surface: An insect landing on an engineer's father.
explanation.definitionFit: Agnate describes relatives linked through the male line.

clue.text: Snogs cure mood swings? — that and some purchases

indicators.note: swings suggests these letters swing about into a new order

explanation.surface: Kissing fixes changes in temper, and so does a spot of shopping.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface nods to retail therapy: a cuddle or a shopping spree cheers you up.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods bought by members of the public for personal use, such as cars or televisions.

clue.text: Contributes a day on empty discussions

indicators.note: in a down clue a and day sit on top of the final piece
empty means removing all the middle, leaving the outside letters

explanation.surface: Someone giving up a day to pointless talk.
explanation.definitionFit: To add is to contribute something extra.

clue.text: One could cut letters of "ironic" with an "s"

indicators.note: letters of suggests the letters of ironic and the s are used freely in any order

explanation.surface: Wordplay instruction about cutting a word and adding a letter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' looks like an instruction on the word; it belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An incisor is a front tooth used for biting and slicing food.

clue.text: On the rocks after a good game of golf

parts.note: a round is one game of golf

explanation.surface: A ship wrecked after a fine afternoon on the links.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship aground is stuck on the shore or a reef.

clue.text: Swelling with pride finally, after show of agreement

indicators.note: after places the pride piece behind the show of agreement

parts.note: a nod shows agreement

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of the word pride

explanation.surface: Puffing up proudly once someone nods in approval.
explanation.definitionFit: A node is a lump or knot, such as a swollen lymph node.

clue.text: The sops were tense, worried before Sunday

indicators.note: before puts the rearranged letters ahead of the Sunday letter
worried suggests the letters are disturbed into a new shape

explanation.surface: Anxious people being placated ahead of Sunday.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of 'were tense' make SWEETENER, then S.
explanation.definitionFit: Sops are concessions given to placate someone, like bribes or inducements.
